units.source_text: 我听说老师极尽嫖色之能事。

en.t: I had heard that the teacher had gone to the utmost extremes of sensual indulgence.

units.source_text: 我想像着老师嫖乐的情形，既感到可笑，又感到惴喘不安。

en.t: When I imagined the teacher amusing himself with women, I found it both ridiculous and deeply unsettling.

units.source_text: 女人被他的桃红色粘糕似的躯体紧紧拥抱，不知会作何感想？

en.t: What would a woman feel, held tightly in his pink, sticky-rice-cake-like body?

units.source_text: 也许她会觉得这桃红色的柔软肉体一直连到世界的尽头，犹如被埋在肉的坟墓里。

en.t: Perhaps she would feel that this soft pink flesh stretched on to the end of the world, as though she had been buried in a tomb of flesh.
